name: Estonia: check of forms and supplied documents

common.check: Trial title and EU trial number (if assigned) match the protocol and CTIS.
Every field the assistant answers is answered; fields that belong to the site, investigator, insurer or sponsor are left empty, not invented.
Language as set in requirements.json: Estonian by default for K1, N1, P1, R1 and S1 (English where chosen under DECISIONS.md D1); English for M1 and M2.

Signatures as set in requirements.json: M1 signed and dated by the Principal Investigator; N1 signed by a person legally authorised by the study centre; no signature on the other forms unless the current form expressly requires one.
CTIS title follows the naming guide and requirements.json; correct CTIS location.
Sponsor name, protocol number and version consistent with the rest of the package.

EE-K1.check: Uses the European Commission Informed Consent and Patient Recruitment Procedure template version 2.0, uploaded under Recruitment arrangements.
Describes how participants are identified and recruited and, where recruitment materials are used, the materials and the process.

Member State fields for Estonia completed: EU CT number on all recruitment materials; compensation information in the ICF, not in advertising; Estonian (and any other intended) participant language; consent discussion with a doctor, nurse or pharmacist of the trial team; signature and dating rules with digital signature allowed; separate consents for participation and for pseudonymised data or sample use.
Remote consent described: video call, electronic identification, legally accepted signature, justified and approved by the Ethics Committee before implementation.
Minors section: co-consent of the minor and the legal representative at 7 to 17; representative authority verified; refusal respected; re-consent at adulthood.
Incapacitated adults section: presumed intent; representative decision not relied on where it clearly harms the participant; information adapted to capacity; regained-capacity consent.
Impartial witness section: trigger, independence, selection, documentation and signatures.
Emergency section: every Article 35 condition, representative search, consent to continue without undue delay, refusal handling and documentation.
Consent pathways match the L1 sets in the package.

EE-M1.check: One English CV per Principal Investigator and Estonian site, uploaded under Suitability of the investigator.
Dated and signed by the Principal Investigator and no more than six months old at submission.
States the most recent GCP training and the year the certificate was issued (no certificate needed when this is in the CV).
Personal details supplied by the investigator, not invented.

EE-M2.check: One declaration of interests per Principal Investigator and site, on the EC template or with equivalent content; interests stated by the investigator.
Signature and date handled as decided in DECISIONS.md D13.

EE-N1.check: One EC Site Suitability Form per Estonian site, uploaded under Suitability of the facilities.
Uses the study centre's legal name (a commonly used English name may follow in parentheses).
Signed by a person legally authorised by the study centre (manual or digital signature).
Uploaded as PDF with the original .asice container retained at the study centre.
EE-N1.applies_when: N1 signed in an Estonian .asice container

EE-N1.check: Site facts (facilities, equipment, procedures, human resources) come from the site and are consistent with the protocol.

EE-O1.check: Insurance certificate states the trial identifier (EU CT number, or protocol number together with the trial title), Estonia as the country, the insurance period and the insured amount.
Academic exemption applied only after eligibility was confirmed under the Medicinal Products Act and the Health Insurance Act; the confirmation is documented.
Insurance and injury wording in the participant documents matches the certificate.

EE-P1.check: Uses the EC Compensation for Trial Participants template.
Reimbursement of unavoidable direct trial-related expenses is stated and justified.
Compensation for inconvenience or burdensome procedures only for competent participants, justified, reflecting time and contribution, not dependent on risk.
No completion bonus, no payment conditional on completion, no large share held back.
Minors, incapacitated participants, their representatives, pregnant women and breastfeeding women receive only reimbursement of direct costs.
Amounts, conditions and recipients identical to every participant document.

EE-P2-BUDGET.check: Transparent trial-budget information is provided; if the per-participant fee is used as the basis, its breakdown is explained.
Confirms that trial-specific services will not be billed to the Estonian Health Insurance Fund.
Consistent with P1 and the site arrangements.

EE-FEE.check: Invoice recipient's details provided, including postal address and one organisation email address based on the CTIS LOC code.
Email address for the decision recipient provided.

Fee exemption claimed only after confirming the current Medicinal Products Act conditions; for the academic exemption, the sponsor type qualifies and the application confirming no financial or other compensation from a medicine manufacturer or its representative (apart from trial medicines) is included.

EE-R1.check: EU statement of compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 completed in the CTIS Form section.
No national sentence added (r1_the_sponsor_declares removed); sponsor details and responsible person from the sponsor.
Consistent with the detailed data-protection explanation in the participant documents.

EE-S1.check: Uses the EC Compliance with Applicable Rules for Biological Samples form.
For each sample type: what is collected, pseudonymised or anonymised, transport, storage location, storage duration in years and time of destruction.
Transfers outside Estonia or the EEA and genetic analysis stated where applicable.
Optional future use described and kept separate from the main-trial consent.
Consistent with the protocol, laboratory manual and participant documents.
